text: Mayor Roz is a human located at Brennadam Square in Stormsong Valley.
Mayhem is a storm dragon located in the Halls of Valor. It was encountered by the champions of the class orders.
Meat Shield is a Blood death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Mouth of Hell and Umbilicus Eternus (artifact trait) traits.

Mehlar Dawnblade is a blood elf paladin initially located at the Bulwark on the border between Tirisfal Glades and the Western Plaguelands. His quests (the Lightbringer quests and the Blood Knight class quest pertaining to the Scourgestone, respectively) are no longer available to players. His counterpart is the draenei Anchorite Truuen at Chillwind Camp. Mehlar is not known for his patience.
Melika Isenstrider is a human located at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. She is the assistant innkeeper and can be found in the main room.

Melia is a human ghost found playing with her friend Sammy near the fountain on Caer Darrow. They are normally invisible, and can only be seen by a player who has equipped the Spectral Essence item from the quest Kirtonos the Herald (quest), or a priest who has equipped The Eye of Divinity.
Meline Duskpath is a night elf tailoring vendor located at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. During Death Rising, she was defending the area.
Melarith is a night elf located at Dolanaar in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Melasong is a blood elf found in Zul'Aman. She has been hexxed into a frog waiting to be saved.
Melissa is a human found in Zul'Aman. She has been hexxed into a frog waiting to be saved.

Melia Sunsoar is a blood elf located at Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds. Considering that she is found next to Kaelis Sunsoar, the two are probably related. She is maintaining the portal to Sparkrocket Outpost.
Melia Stoneshaker is a dwarf. She is a graduate of Brock's School of Mining and Surveying and Gremlock's School of Caterers.

Melhen Lightfury is a blood elf paladin located in Stratholme. She can be chosen to accompany the Highlord throughout the scenario during Stirring in the Shadows. Following the split of the Order during the Fourth War, she is no longer a member of the Silver Hand.
Medic Bot is a clockwork robot of Dizzy Dina located at Boralus Harbor in Boralus.
Melissa Miller is a human located in Scribes & Nobles in Boralus.
Megan Voss is a human located in Pinky's Groggery in Boralus.
Melissa Kenny is a human located in Foxhollow Woods in Tiragarde Sound.
Melindra Quarry is a human located at the Alliance encampment at the outskirts of the Ruins of Lordaeron during Battle for Lordaeron.
Mel Oakraven is a night elf located in Shady Sanctuary in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Meehran Highlock is a human innkeeper and vendor located in the Waking Shores.
Meligos was a blue dragon who was killed by Neltharion's betrayal during the War of the Ancients. His name is on a Crumbling Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.

Menara Voidrender is a human warlock located in Ratchet of Northern Barrens where she tutors young students in the arcane. According to Briarthorn she is an expert in the creation of orbs that imprison demons. She and Tabetha have a history together. During the Legion Invasions she summoned imps.
Mendez Nightshadow is a night elf located at the Circle of Wills in the Underbelly.
Mender Aelar is a night elf mender located at the Thas'talah Basin in Val'sharah. He is mending some injured druids.
Melvin Shirtson is a human located at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands. He is found kneeling in front of the statue of Tirion Fordring. He provides the Threads of Tirion for free.
Mender Dyrin is a human located at the Ruins of Ammon in Uldum.
Mending Proliferation is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Unison.
Meri Ironweave is a night elf armor & shield vendor located in Dolanaar in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

Merideth Carlson is a human horse vendor located in Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. She was a bit of a nut-job and had troubles with the Knights of the Silver Hand because they didn't believe her stories about being able to prepare a special horse feed that could nourish spiritual horses. She was eventually humbled by a paladin that offered to pay a small fortune for her blend. With the destruction of Southshore by Forsaken plague-bombing, Merideth's fate is unclear.
Mercutio Filthgorger is a dwarf found near the Undercroft in the Eastern Plaguelands. He spawns with an escort of several Crypt Robbers after the Loose Dirt Mound has been searched.

Merchant Frostwalker is a general goods vendor onboard the Elune's Blessing, the boat that runs between Teldrassil and Valaar's Berth in the Azuremyst Isle. He sells general goods as well as providing repairs.
Merciless Combat was a Death knight talent located in the 6th tier of the Frost Tree.
Mercurial Vestments is the tier 11 holy/discipline priest set.

Merina is a human ghost who appears in the Abandoned Kirin Tor Camp in Deadwind Pass after looting the Ritual Notes during The Deadwind Site. She was seemingly part of the disastrous ritual conducted by Arrexis but was killed while attempting to protect the Ritual Focusing Crystal from "the monsters". After the player loots the Ritual Focusing Crystal, which is lying near Merina's corpse, her ghost disappears.
Mental Fortitude is a Shadow priest artifact trait. It is linked to the Void Corruption trait.
Merris Townsend is a human located in the Command Center at Deliverance Point in the Broken Shore.

Mercy Fairwater is a human spirit located at the Barrowknoll Cemetery in Drustvar. In life, she was a priestess of the Light and one of the valiant champions of Drustvar, known as the Defenders of Drustvar. During the Drust incursion, a witch from the Heartsbane Coven, named Sister Westwood, summoned her soul and those of her companions to put them into a wicker construct in order to bring death upon the lands they have sworn to protect. Her soul was saved by an Alliance emissary who stopped the rituals and killed the witch.
Merris Deepforge is a dwarf located at the Alliance encampment at the outskirts of the Ruins of Lordaeron during Battle for Lordaeron.
Meredy Huntswell is a dwarf mage located in Exile's Reach. She and several other Exile's Reach survivors end up on Khaz Algar joining incomplete hero parties to take on dungeons.

Michelle Belle is a human located at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, in Elwynn Forest. She teaches tailors how to craft bandages. Michelle is located in the upstairs section of the inn, in the central room, along with Priestess Josetta.

Metz is a human located in Eastern Plaguelands and Zul'Drak. He first appeared as Dispatch Commander Metz as a quest giver located at Light's Hope Chapel in the Light's Hope Chapel of the Eastern Plaguelands. He is affiliated with the Argent Dawn and is extremely rude. During the war against the Lich King, he appeared as Avenger Metz in the Argent Stand in Zul'Drak. He, Eitrigg and some others were inspecting the saronite. Strangely enough, despite joining the Argent Crusade and being promoted to the rank of Avenger during the war against the Lich King, Metz is back to being affiliated to the Argent Dawn after the Cataclysm.
Micah Stonebreaker is a level 72 dwarf, captured and held in a cage in the middle of New Agamand in the Howling Fjord. The Forsaken of New Amagand test their poisons on him.
Mia Greymane is the wife of Genn Greymane and former queen consort of Gilneas.
Michelle De Rum is a human found in the Laughing Yeti inn of Everlook, surrounded by two sleeping Winterspring Cubs.
Metopious Loreseeker is a high elf located at the Circle of Wills in the Underbelly. He can be seen speaking with Lofwyr Le'Fleur.
Micah is a human child found in Zul'Aman. He has been hexxed into a frog waiting to be saved.
Mia Linn is a human located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Midshipman Nawrog was an orc located at the Highmaul Harbor in . She traveled with Admiral Kronnor to negotiate with Ambassador Lonn'mog. They were all taken out by the followers sent from the Frostwall and Lunarfall garrisons.
Mi'ael Daybreaker is a night elf located at Thas'talah in Val'sharah.
Michelle McQueen is a human located at Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound.
Michael Troutman is a human located in Pinky's Groggery in Boralus.
Michele Wise is a human located in Arom's Stand in Drustvar. She cares for the local Thicket Hares.
Michael Skarn is a human located in Barbthorn Ridge in Drustvar.
Mia Pyke is a human located at Wingrest Embassy in the Waking Shores.
Michael Robbins is a human located at the Azure Archives in the Azure Span. A Crystaline Engery Conduit can be found next to him.
Midormi is a bronze dragon located at the Ruby Life Pools in the Waking Shores.

Miner Johnson is a rare elite human found in the Deadmines. He is located before the shredder in a little alcove to the left with all the other miners. He is a random spawn, meaning he may not always appear in the instance.
Mike Miller is a human bread vendor located at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Miner Hackett is a human found within Azurelode Mine in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He killed a Forsaken deathstalker named Fry. High Executor Darthalia wanted Hackett killed in revenge.

Mimblis Evermorne was a paladin and member of the Knights of the Silver Hand. He was a friend of Uther Lightbringer. Uther wrote him a letter in the year 24 in which he spoke of Arthas. Arthas had recently become a full paladin and had great qualities, yet one disturbing quality Uther noted was that "He lacks control". Uther also said that "His relationship with Jaina Proudmoore is one that he must watch."
Mill Courier is a level 30 human peasant that carries small logs of wood from the lumber mill to the ship docked at the seaport of Theramore Isle.
Mindbender is a Discipline and Shadow priest talent that replaces Shadowfiend.

Mindbender Talbadar is a Forsaken shadow priest captain of the Horde, who served in Ashran and would later appear at Raven's Glory, the Black Rook Hold arena. In Ashran, Talbadar or another random Horde Captain will spawn each time the Horde reinforcements total reaches 200 or 100.
Mina Kunis is a human located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Minerva Ravensorrow is an undead death knight of the Knights of the Ebon Blade.
Mikal Joplin is a human located at the Old Coast Path in Azsuna.
Mind-Controlled Dreadwing is a vampire bat located in Stormheim. He is controlled by Tinkmaster Overspark who adores him.
Mimiron's Shell is a Beast Mastery hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Focus of the Titans and Jaws of Thunder traits.
Millie Townsend is a human located in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands.
Mikah Brewbelly is a dwarf located in Mezzamere in Nazjatar.
Mike Porter is a human located in Area 52 in Netherstorm. He is seen speaking with Bill Porter.
Miner Cletus Proudrock is a human located in Three-Falls Lookout in the Azure Span. His team consists of Healer Dalagh, Modurun Sixtoes, and Excavator Silversun.
Mishta is a night elf trade goods vendor located at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Misdirection is a row 4 hunter talent. It redirects threat caused by the hunter onto a friendly target for 8 seconds.
Mirla Silverblaze is a high elf guild vendor found at the Dalaran Visitor Center in Dalaran.
Mishka is a SI:7 draenei agent. She is mainly called on as a field medic for whatever missions she's on. She also doubles as a first aid trainer for players. Her personal weapon is a bow.

Captain Mirra was a Theramore soldier under Colonel Lorena. When Lorena received an order from Kristoff to lead Northwatch Hold's forces, Mirra was amongst those whom Lorena chose as her senior staff. However, Lorena did not go to Northwatch and instead went to search Jaina Proudmoore. She succeeded and Mirra and the others returned to Theramore Isle. It is unknown whether he survived the destruction of Theramore.
Miriam Brassbomb is a dwarf stable master located at Tranquil Wash in Shimmering Expanse.
Misirin Stouttoe is a dwarf of the Explorers' League found in Stormshield Stronghold in Ashran. She can be found talking to Grimnir Sternhammer.
Mirkat was an orc warlock trainer located in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. She is currently absent.

Mirana Starlight is a night elf warden who answers to Maiev Shadowsong. Mirana was among a group of wardens sent to during the conflict against the Iron Horde there, with the duty of protecting Archmage Khadgar. After the end of the war, she joined her fellow wardens on the Broken Isles, where they maintained a base on the Isle of the Watchers under the command of Maiev Shadowsong. Later, with the beginning of the Fourth War, she pledged herself to the Alliance cause, and took part in the Battle for Darkshore alongside the other kaldorei.
Mirran Lichbane is a human located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Miracle Worker is a Holy priest talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Restitution.
Miranda Moyer is a human banker located at Tradewinds Counting House in Boralus.
Mirror Ball is a Frost death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Bad to the Bone, Ambidexterity (death knight artifact trait), and Cold as Ice traits.
Mirugosa was a blue dragon who was slain by her kin. Her name is on a Crumbling Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.

Miss Fifi is a mushan beast rewarded to players when they become best friends with Haohan Mudclaw in The Tillers storyline. She wanders the area just to the north of Sunsong Ranch, grazing. She is there for cosmetic purposes only; she cannot be interacted with and performs no other actions.

Missy Flamecuffs is a gnome mage part of the Hodir encounter in Ulduar. She, along with her excavation team are trapped inside icicle blocks and must be freed if the raid wants help against Hodir. In 25man version she is replaced by Sissy Flamecuffs.
Mist Wrap is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Refreshing Jade Wind.
Mistaaytch is a night elf located in the Gnarled Branch at the Dreamgrove in Val'sharah.

Mitrius is an old human druid who has had some success trading with a murloc tribe. He had spent two years on the Shiverwind Coast, studying various plants and sea creatures, and his camp was less than a day's travel from a murloc tribe. After a few months the tribe no longer felt him dangerous and began to trade with him. At some point they even invited Mitrius into their home. He became a regular guest, and was able to ask them many questions about their culture. He is known for being the most tolerated non-murloc in all Azeroth, and being one of, if not the eminent, expert on murlocs.
Mizzy Bobble is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Misty Koret is a human located at Fort Daelin in Stormsong Valley.
Mistweaving is a Mistweaver monk artifact trait. It is not linked to any other traits and requires all other Base traits to be learned.

Mithdran Dawntracker is a blood elf stable master located in Exile's Reach. He helps hunters tame their first pet and teaches them how to use Freezing Trap. He may be a member of the Farstriders, since he tells blood elf hunters that he'll gladly teach them the Farstriders' ways.

Mojo Stormstout is a pandaren monk trainer found in Ammen Vale in Azuremyst Isle. He was on Azuremyst Isle when the Exodar crashed, and offered to give the survivors aid. Vindicator Aldar proposed that he help by teaching survivors fighting skills.
Mondul is an orc meat and drink vendor located at Spinebreaker Post in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Mokasa is an orc located at Stonebreaker Hold in Terokkar Forest.

Molten Shields is a mage Fire talent that reduces the cooldown of Mage Ward by 1 second and allows Mage Ward to trigger Blazing Speed after absorbing its full damage. This gives another mechanic for getting the speed buff from Blazing Speed and improves the utility of Mage Ward. This is more of a PvP talent than PvE, since a mage doesn't usually need an escape mechanism in PvE.
Monann Coldforge is a dwarf general goods vendor located at Bahrum's Post in Dun Morogh.
Molten Giant Battleplate is the tier 12 protection warrior set.
Mogg is an orc child located south of the Mor'shan Rampart in the Northern Barrens. He wants to become a warrior just like his father. He was present during the Legion Invasions.

Monara was the last queen of the mogu during the Age of a Hundred Kings, but was killed by Lei Shen so that he could start a new empire. Her tormented spirit now rests within the Throne of Thunder. Occasionally the weekly quest will allow players to kill this spirit, which will replace the Soul-Fed Construct for that week.
Mok is an orc shaman trainer located at the Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.
Mokugg Lagerpounder is an orc fisherman found at the Southwind Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge. He has a frost wolf companion named Swift.
Mol'dana Two-Blade is an orc found at the Burning Font in Blackrock Foundry.
Molin Heavypack is a dwarf vendor located in Redemption Rise in Talador.
Mograg is an orc follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Moio Kollo is a dwarf located in Camp Nowhere in the Azure Span.
Mograine is a human family name primarily located in Lordaeron.
Monster Slaying is a hunter talent in the Survival tree. You will need to spend 3 points in Survival to max it.
Montegue Krole is a human located at Light's Trust in Dragonblight.
Mongar is an orc mining and blacksmithing supplies vendor located at Tanks for Everything in Dalaran.
Monica Winters is a human located in Hops, Line, & Sinker Brewing in Boralus.

Morgan Ladimore was a soldier of Grand Hamlet (now known as Darkshire) who participated in the Third War. As he went to help fight in Lordaeron, his homeland was laid waste. When he returned from the war Morgan could not find his wife Lys nor their children. He went mad, and in his madness killed several innocents. When he came to, he saw what had come to pass and committed suicide. His body was reanimated and became an undead monstrosity known as Mor'Ladim, who once roamed near Raven Hill and killed indiscriminately.
Morley Eberlein is a human cloth armor vendor located on the fourth floor of the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.
Moorat Longstride is a tauren general goods vendor located in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.
Morhan Coppertongue is a dwarf mail armor vendor located in Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

Morg Gnarltree is a human armor vendor located in Darkshire in Duskwood. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Morg was killed by the fanatical Night Watchers who joined the Veiled Hand cult.

Morbent Fell was a lich of the Scourge, though he was loyal to the Burning Legion and not to the Lich King. During the Scourge civil war, Fell became a follower of the dreadlord Balnazzar. During the siege of Lordaeron, Fell commanded a faction of undead dubbed the Dreadlord Loyalists and was presumably killed by the forces of Sylvanas, Varimathras and Garithos.
Morbidity is a Death knight talent located on the 2nd tier of the Unholy Tree.
Archmage Mordent Evenshade is the leader of the Shen'dralar Highborne that have reintegrated into night elven society.

Morlen Coldgrip was a death knight who served under Arthas Menethil during the invasion of Quel'Thalas. He personally led the Scourge force that slew Thalorien Dawnseeker. He appears in the quest Thalorien Dawnseeker (quest).

Morgan is the leader of Morgan's Militia. Her family used to own land in the Burning Steppes until the Dark Iron dwarves and Ragnaros killed them and drove her people away. Having returned from her vigil, she seeks to go on the offensive on the Dark Iron dwarves of Blackrock Depths and establish her own kingdom in the Burning Steppes. After the Cataclysm, she makes her first ever appearance, having previously been absent from her namesake outpost.
Moriana Dawnlight is a night elf in a room halfway up the top of Aldrassil. She is discussing things with Doranel Amberleaf. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Morina was a night elf killed by Ralaar and Arvell while they had lost their minds to the Pack Form.

Morick Darkbrew is a rare Dark Iron dwarf found in Loch Modan. As a courier, he works alongside infiltrator Gorick Guzzledraught. He may be one of the messengers referenced in the text of Gorick's Stash List.
Moraka is an orc inscription vendor located in the Mighty Pen shop in the the upper level of the Drag in Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, she was seen speaking with Sinzi Sparkscribe.

Moray was a Wildhammer dwarf during the Second War. He was one of the Wildhammers who fell during the second raid on the orcs who were helped by the forest trolls. His death was reported to Kurdran by Beathan.

Mor'riz is a jungle troll druid captain of the Horde, who served in Ashran and would later appear at Raven's Glory, the Black Rook Hold arena. In Ashran, Mor'riz or another random Horde Captain will spawn each time the Horde reinforcements total reaches 200 or 100.

Mordak Darkfist is an orc warlock located in the Darkfire Enclave in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. After the Burning Legion launched their third invasion, he can be seen in Dreadscar Rift and is observing a group of Black Harvest Acolytes. He is also found in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore, holding a Captured Inquisitor captive with a fel chain, while Elithys Firestorm interrogated the demon. Mordak was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar. Next to him were Arnak Fireblade and Ritssyn Flamescowl. Mordak and Arnak stepped forward to represent their clan, the Burning Blade.

Morgan Montaine is a human mercenary and the father of Rufus Montaine with whom he visited Durnholde and watched the orc Thrall in fights. Rufus was impressed in the orc and wanted to fight him but Morgan was against it. He was goaded into giving permission by fellow mercenaries and Blackmoore himself. Years later, he got into shady dealings and his son left him to join the Proudmoore family. Morgan's father fought with Admiral Proudmoore in the Second War.
Mordeki Haribull is a human located at the Deadwash in Stormsong Valley. He is seen practicing on a tranining dummy.

Morka Bruggu is an orc soldier of the Horde. She participated in the war against the Burning Legion and later served as a guard in Orgrimmar before being assigned as one of Varok Saurfang's personal guards during the War of the Thorns. She is married to a blacksmith and has eight children.
Mordigan Ironjaw is a Dark Iron dwarf located in Whaler's Nook in the Azure Span. He is a skilled geologist of the Dragonscale Expedition.
Morata Glowheart is a tauren mage found in Arcane Enclave in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.

Morphaz is an elite green drake and member of the Wardens of the Dream found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. He appears in the central chamber when Jammal'an the Prophet is defeated. Eranikus has 4 young but fit and eager green drakes under his direct command: Dreamscythe, Weaver, Hazzas, and Morphaz - who themselves command a huge army of Nightmare dragonspawn and whelps. Years ago, Morphaz overwhelmed Archmage Xylem in a bold ambush and consumed a whole apprentice. While Xylem was not overly concerned with the loss of the apprentice, this particular one was carrying an arcane shard of unsurpassed size and quality that he wishes retrieved.
Motley Garmason is a dwarf located outside Dun Modr in the Alliance-aligned territory of the Wetlands.
Mother Om'ra is an orc spirit. She is also part of the Gara taming.
Morva Soultwister is an orc located in the Black Altar of Xan'tish in .
Moroes' Famous Polish is an interesting toy which strips the character of their armor for 10 minutes.
Morticia Crowley is a forsaken death knight follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Motina is an orc follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Mortar Sergeant Stouthammer was a dwarf located in Silithus.
Morto Dourmaw is an orc located in Warfang Hold in Stormsong Valley.
Morneth is an orc who would be present in the Bonetown Scenario.
Mortal Dance is a Havoc demon hunter talent. It enables the demon hunter to apply a healing debuff to targets.

Mozza is a Wildhammer dwarf of Aerie Peak and good friend of Lieren. Mozza is seen sparring with Lieren and Keers. Lieren became such a well-trained warrior that she could easily outmatch both Mozza and Keers at the same time. Lieren faked a defeat from one of Mozza's attacks so as not to hurt Keers' and Mozza's pride thinking that they wouldn't want to spar with her any longer if she keeps besting them in training. Keers sees through her ruse and tells her that faking defeats out of pity is unnecessary as he and Mozza are her friends.
Multi-Shot is a hunter talent, located on row 2 of the Beast Mastery tree and row 6 of the Marksmanship tree.

Mukdrak is an orc artisan engineering trainer located in Razor Hill in Durotar. During the events of the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar, he was constructing something. Next to him were Engineering Tools.
Muigin is a human located at Marshal's Refuge in the Un'Goro Crater.
Mu'uta is an orc bow vendor located in Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.
Mudduk is an orc cooking trainer located in Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
Msshi'fn is the leader of the sporelings located in Sporeggar in Zangarmarsh.

Mugg'roth ("Ogre" in-game, "Orge" in concept art) was a character in the canceled adventure game Warcraft Adventures. He guarded the entrance to Grommash Hellscream's hideout in an orcish reservation. The beardless head was rendered an imbecile when part of an ogre mound fell on them, causing this head to trade the bearded head's spell book to Zul'jin for a piece of meat. The bearded head passed the time by playing a card game similar to . Thrall had to steal the cards in order to trade with Clawhand, and eventually get back the spell book. After Thrall returned the spell book to them, he tricked the ogre mage into stepping on one of their own runes by leading the beardless head across it wi
Muln Earthfury is a tauren shaman and the former leader of the Earthen Ring.
Mule Driver Ironshod is a dwarf stable master in the Alliance section of the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.
Mullony Shipswain is a dwarf found at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Mulverick is an orc found in Frostfire Ridge. Liberated from imprisonment by the ogres during the reclamation of the area around Bladespire Citadel, he later entered the service of the Horde commander in charge of the Frostwall garrison. He can also be seen watching fights between garrison commanders in the Coliseum of Highmaul.

Mukkral Blackvein is an orc follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern. He later went on to become outpost commander of Wolf's Den in Tiragarde Sound.
Muffinus Chromebrew is a gnome hunter trainer located at New Tinkertown in Dun Morogh.
Muka Stormbreaker is an orc located at Warfang Hold in Stormsong Valley.
Murndan Derth is a dwarf gun vendor located in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

Murta Grimgut is an elite dwarf priest found in Zul'Farrak. Murta is and assists during the Pyramid battle, but becomes during the Sergeant Bly event. She will still heal you during the event if you remain unflagged. Although she shares the same last name with Gor Grimgut, they are apparently not related.
Murrik Doubletoe was a dwarf whose son was kidnapped by the Syndicate. The Syndicate didn't want any ransom, but rather help driving the Crushridge clan of ogres away from Alterac.

Mur'og was an orc Stone Guard of an unknown clan sometime before the rise of the first Horde, but at a time when orcs had encountered the summoning of dreadlords. His life is now remembered through the Maul of Stone Guard Mur'og which can be found using archaeology in Outland.
Murphy West is a human located at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. He is helping the town by bringing in sand bags, since the flood. He previously hung out in the tavern's basement.

Muraga is an orc herbalism trainer located in the shop The Arboretum on the upper level of the Drag in Orgrimmar. She walks around the shop tending the plants. After Vol'jin's death, she was seen speaking with Brunda, and crying.
Murkhad was a Wildhammer dwarf during the Second War. He died in Quel'Thalas when he was charging towards a red dragon and ended up being eaten along with his gryphon.
Murg Stonecrack is an orc mining trainer found behind Warspear's Gallywix's Garage on Ashran. Ricky Bozwallop is interested into hiring him.
Murgtar is an orc follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Mushhuckster Max is a kobold priest featured in the Kobolds & Catacombs expansion for Hearthstone. Mushhuckster Max is a kobold who specializes in potions.
Murphy Watson is a character that appears on the following World of Warcraft: Trading Card Game cards. *Wrathgate #142 - Murphy Watson *Class Starter 2011: Horde Death Knight #19 - Murphy Watson

Master Sergeant Murgatroyd Smith was a human who fought during the Second War. As a member of Kul Tiras, he was part of the marine army whose battles were all at sea. While on the Songswallow, he would die during the Battle of Crestfall when red dragons breath fire on their vessels, sending their ships to the bottom of the sea. In the present day, he is one of the Drowned Sailors.
Munovuth Boldcleaver is an orc located in Stonefist Watch in Tiragarde Sound.

Muqur Swiftshot is a centaur spirit who roams Timberstep Outpost in the Ohn'ahran Plains, pacing back and forth between Shurom's tent in the north and the rivershore next to Ranger Otyuk in the south. She is normally invisible and can only be seen while the player character is under the effect of Essence of Awakening. Gifting her Enchant Boots - Plainsrunner's Breeze is required for Honor Our Ancestors.
Myra Tyrngaarde is a wandering dwarf bread vendor located in the Commons in Ironforge.
Muzz Flimspan is a goblin general goods vendor located at the Irontree Clearing in Felwood.
Mysandra Swiftarc is a night elf located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Myshal Ravendancer is a night elf found at the night elven camp in Stormshield. He and Priestess Llaenia are discussing the Ancient Artifact that Harrison Jones is searching for.
My Beloved Monster is a Survival hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Sharpened Fang, Terms of Engagement (artifact trait), Bird of Prey (hunter artifact trait) and Hunter's Bounty traits.
Myria Glenbrook is a night elf general goods vendor for Lightsong, Val'sharah.
Mythexthia is a black dragon accompanying Sabellian in the Obsidian Citadel in the Waking Shores. After the Citadel has been reclaimed, she relocates to Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
Nadyia Maneweaver is a night elf artisan leatherworking trainer located northwest of the Ban'ethil Hollow in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Naela Trance is a human bow vendor located in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
Nandar Branson is a human alchemy vendor located in Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. With the destruction of Southshore by Forsaken plague bombing in the Cataclysm, Nandar's fate is unclear.
Nalesette Wildbringer is a night elf stable master located at Talonbranch Glade in Felwood.
Nalorakk is the Amani lord of bears. He is one of the four animal bosses in the Zul'Aman instance. He guards the cage containing the troll male, Tanzar as part of the Zul'Aman Timed Event.

Nalice is a black dragon found at Wyrmrest Temple and later in the Master's Cellar of Deadwind Pass. She was killed by an adventurer seeking the Fangs of the Father, tasked by Wrathion to obtain a vial of her blood.

Prince Nallorath (also called Nall by his friends) was a high elf prince 2,600 years before the First War when the demons started attacking Dalaran. He was the best friend of the half-elf Alodi. Nallorath was also a mage of the Kirin Tor. Council of Tirisfal members Ethylar and Rohar were magi at his father's court, while Aertin Brighthand used to be. He did not know of the Council, nor of Ethylar's, Rohar's, and Aertin's connection to it.

Nag'zehn is an orc located at Ironstone Camp in Thousand Needles. He seem to be member of the orcish war party led by Moktar Krin. The following are supposedly also members of said war party: *Tarkreu Shadowstalker *Bor'zehn *War Party Kodo Following the Cataclysm, he, alongside Bor'zehn, can be found fighting the Grimtotem that have taken over Freewind Post.

Nahu Ragehoof is a tauren warrior trainer located in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. He was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade and fought against Felblade Assassins.
Na Lek is a water spirit guardian of the Pools of Youth in Krasarang Wilds. The mogu entrapped it and will aid heroes that free it.
Naka Scaleblade is an orc blacksmith vendor located at Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands.

Lok'osh Nakha is a Mag'har orc and the founder of the Lok'osh, a discipline of orc priests. She appears in Garadar in Nagrand as the quest giver Seer Nakha, and at the waterfall in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor as the priest trainer Lok'osh Nakha. During the invasion of Outland, Seer Nakha received a vision of the X-52 Nether-Rocket being constructed in Area 52. Unsure what to make of the vision, she told Horde adventurers to go to Area 52 and aid in the rocket's construction. Nakha watched as one of the adventurers solved the mystery of the orcs' restless ancestor spirits, who were being drawn into Oshu'gun by the darkened naaru K'ure. Na'Shra is an orc from the Frostwolf clan located in Gate of the Breakers near Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge. She is present during the Battle of Thunder Pass. She becomes a follower in the Frostwall garrison.
Nance Doubleblade is a dwarf located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Napp'agosh is a orc found in the Sha'tari Market District after the Battle for Shattrath's conclusion, he is seen unconscious by one of the Iron Horde's cannonball pods with Goh'kuu kneeling by his side. It is unknown what becomes of both him and Goh'kuu after leads the takeover of .
Nadia Darksun is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Nakeeta Coldtalon is an orc located at the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
Naman is an orc vendor located in Darsok's Outpost in Northern Barrens. During the Burning Legion's invasion, she was injured but rescued by the adventurers.
Nalmeena Darkfollow is a night elf warden. A tower in Val'sharah is probably named after her: Darkfollow's Spire.
Nance Barmy is a human located in Freehold in Tiragarde Sound.
Naissillia Crimsonheart is a blood elf located in Theron's Watch in the Azure Span.
Natheril Raincaller is a night elf general goods vendor located in Starfall Village in Winterspring.

Naralex is a night elf druid found sleeping in the Wailing Caverns. He also appears as a quest giver in the Overgrown Camp in Southern Barrens. He intended to use the Emerald Dream to restore the Barrens to the lush forest they once were; however, once he connected to the Dream the Emerald Nightmare overwhelmed him. Most of his disciples were driven insane and formed the Druids of the Fang. He was eventually saved by a group of adventurers and one of his last disciples, Muyoh. Naram Longclaw is a night elf weapon vendor located in Auberdine in Darkshore. He was presumably killed in the Cataclysm, as he is nowhere to be found.
Nargal Deatheye is an orc weapon vendor located at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Narj Deepslice is a dwarf meat vendor located at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands.
Nargatt is an orc food and drink vendor located in Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
Nath is an ogre war god. Among ogres, bone crushers are seen as the living avatars of him. Perhaps one of the gronn, or an even greater demigod.

Narn is a dwarf who helped Vereesa Windrunner and Falstad Dragonreaver fight trolls in Khaz Modan. He was badly injured in the battle against the cannibalistic trolls and was not fit to travel along with the rest of the group to Grim Batol.
Narrhok Steelbreaker is a Horde tauren warrior found at the Argent Tournament in Icecrown. He also has a chance to appear in the Trial of the Crusader against the Alliance.
Nathan Blaine is a human found in Northwatch Hold within the Southern Barrens. He is signaling the various forces from afar atop a tower, as per Admiral Aubrey's orders.
Private Nash was a human killed by an orc during the battle of Northwatch Hold. Corporal Rych avenged his death by killing the orc back.
Narim was an orc who murdered her mate in a fit of jealousy. She used a Rusted Steak Knife.

Nathaniel Beastbreaker is a Forsaken hunter that has appeared in Frostwall and Trueshot Lodge. Nathaniel can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern. Nathaniel appears at the Trueshot Lodge to help aid the Unseen Path against the Burning Legion.
Natural Reflexes is a Beast Mastery hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Hunter's Advantage and Spitting Cobras traits.
Nara Vel is a human located in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands.

Narg Snarl is an orc captain who served directly under general Orgrim Doomhammer when they were fighting against the Alliance. Once, Snarl disrespected a peon calling him a pushdug. Snarl asked Orgrim why they tolerated "the little chillbloods". Orgrim, in turn, asked him if he would like to set up a catapult and commanded him to perform peons' tasks. Narg quickly reported to a peonmaster. Suddenly every peon within earshot broke into fits of hysterical laughter. Snarl was furious and vowed retribution against the peons when his rank of captain would be restored. The peonmaster caught Snarl with a quick lash to his unprotected neck that made him yelp. Narthok Shadowsight is an orc who would be present in the Bonetown Scenario.
Nature's Endurance is a row 5 hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Lone Survivor.
Neal Allen is a human engineering and general goods vendor located on the bridge to Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
Necrolord X'avius is a human located at the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight.
Necrolord Horus is a human necromancer located in the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight.
Navigator Anderlain is a human aboard The Skybreaker in Icecrown.
Navigator Dobbs is a level 80 human aboard The Skybreaker in Icecrown.
Naveen Tendernose is a Wildhammer dwarf innkeeper in Thundermar in the Twilight Highlands.
Navigator is a level 12 orc alongside Admiral Stormblood on the Horde warship fleet assisting the Forsaken in their attack on Gilneas.
Necrolord Amarion is a human necromancer located at the Wintergarde Crypt in the Dragonblight. Cavalier Durkon asks Alliance adventurers to kill Amarion.
Navic Greenbark is a night elf found inside the Stormshield Barracks in Stormshield. He is tending to a wounded Stormshield Guard.
Navigator Brynn Fuchs is a human located aboard Turalyon's Might in Bladefist Bay during the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Neal Padley is a human located in Bear's Head in Azshara. He is speaking with Elaine Clayton.
Navigator Hudson is a human crewman of The Relentless, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Boralus.

Navigator Swink is a human located in Plunder Harbor within Tiragarde Sound. Originally a member of the Alliance, Swing would defect and join the Fogsail Freebooters under the command of Captain Rhenik. During First Mate Owings mutiny, Swink was approached by an adventurer of the Horde, who gave him false orders that Captain Rhenik wanted to open the harbor to the Horde. Outraged over this Swink attacked and in the subsequently battle lost his life with his dying words expressing glory to the Alliance.
Necromancer's Bargain is an Unholy death knight PvP talent, available at level 29.
Navigator Meyer is a human helmsman of The Kraken, the ship that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Valiance Keep.
Chieftain Nek'rosh Skullcrusher was an orc found in the Wetlands. Usually guarded by 5 orcs, he was the target of Defeat Nek'rosh.
Needlemeyer is a dwarf of the Explorers' League located in Explorers' League Outpost in Howling Fjord.
Neferatti is an orc inscription trainer located on the second floor of the tower up the hill in Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.
Necrotic Boneplate Battlegear is the tier 13 frost/unholy death knight set.
Necrotic Boneplate Armor is the tier 13 blood death knight set.
Neka is an orc reagents and poisons vendor located in Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands. Neka fell during the Iron Horde attack on Nethergarde. Her body was found alongside a potion.
Neesa Nox is a goblin engineer and an elite mercenary of the Blackfuse Company found in Iron Docks as a part of the Grimrail Enforcers along with Ahri'ok Dugru and Makogg Emberblade.
Necrotic Aura is a death knight PvP talent, available at level 35.
Nedly Grinner is a human located at the Deadwash in Stormsong Valley.
Neltharion's Thunder is a Protection warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Gleaming Scales and Concordance of the Legionfall traits.
Ned is a human located in Blacktooth's Grin in Freehold in Tiragarde Sound.
Necrotic Wounds is an Unholy death knight PvP talent, available at level 30.

Nendis was a night elf seaport town in the Azshara region of Kalimdor. The town was razed by the naga on orders from Illidan, who used the port to escape to the Broken Isles. Maiev Shadowsong and the Watchers left the razed town in pursuit of Illidan without searching for survivors.
